title: IFC property set
description: An IfcPropertySet, flattened to the values it holds. One row per property set in the file, however many objects share it: IFC lets a single set define hundreds of elements, and the reference on each of those nodes points back at the one row.

expressId.description: The line number the property set had in the file.

name.description: The set's name, such as Pset_WallCommon. This is also the name of the reference that points at this row.

properties.description: Property name to value. A single value becomes a string, number or boolean; an enumerated or list property becomes an array; a bounded property becomes an object with lowerBound, upperBound and setPointValue; a complex property becomes a nested object.
